items.title: Bill Kirchner interviewed by Monk Rowe, via Zoom, June 4, 2021
items.q: But Joe was, I mean he was such a nice man. Always had his camera too.

ctx.x: Yes. It was very touching and lovely. And I wonder, being friends or associating with gentlemen like Joe from his generation, I’ve had this most marvelous fortunate experience to have a few associations. I wonder what you learned from those guys?

Oh man, well in Joe’s case I mean Joe was the quintessential gentleman in every respect, just the sweetest man and an extraordinary player. But I mean just the way he carried himself. Always had a suit and tie on you know? I mean just the epitome of class, as was somebody else I was fortunate to be able to call a friend and that was Benny Carter, who I got to be good friends with for 25 years. And guys like that, I mean they were just so cool and such great musicians and such great classy people. You know I mean…
